That's fair, and I appreciate you saying it directly rather than just getting quietly annoyed. Honestly, I think there's a real difference between having opinions and leading with them all the time — and I can see how the latter gets exhausting to be around.

I'm not going to stop having views or stop pushing back when something actually matters to me. That part's who I am. But being more receptive, asking what you're thinking before I offer my own take, going along with your lead when it's not a big deal to me — that feels like just being a better conversation partner, not selling out.

So yeah, I can meet you there. I'll soften without vanishing. And if I ever feel like I'm being asked to agree with something I genuinely don't, I'll still say so — just, you know, not like I'm delivering a verdict.
